an8.53:1.1: I have heard that at on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Vesāli at the Gabled Hall in the Great Forest.
an8.53:1.2: Then Mahāpajāpati Gotamī went to the Blessed One and, on arrival, having bowed down to him, stood to one side. As she was standing there she said to him:
an8.53:2.1: “It would be good, lord, if the Blessed One would teach me the Dhamma in brief such that, having heard the Dhamma from the Blessed One, I might dwell alone, secluded, heedful, ardent, & resolute.”
an8.53:2.2: “Gotamī, the qualities of which you may know,
an8.53:2.3: ‘These qualities lead to passion, not to dispassion;
an8.53:2.4: to being fettered, not to being unfettered;
an8.53:2.9: to laziness, not to aroused persistence;
an8.53:2.10: to being burdensome, not to being unburdensome’:
an8.53:2.12: ‘This is not the Dhamma, this is not the Vinaya, this is not the Teacher’s instruction.’
an8.53:3.1: “As for the qualities of which you may know,
an8.53:3.2: ‘These qualities lead to dispassion, not to passion;
an8.53:3.3: to being unfettered, not to being fettered;
an8.53:3.8: to aroused persistence, not to laziness;
an8.53:3.9: to being unburdensome, not to being burdensome’:
an8.53:3.11: ‘This is the Dhamma, this is the Vinaya, this is the Teacher’s instruction.’” That is what the Blessed One said. Gratified, Mahāpājapati Gotamī delighted in his words.
